title: Kissed Irish Quinoa Pilaf
description: A tender and flavorful quinoa pilaf infused with the richness of Irish sausages, carrots, and onions.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and sauté until translucent, about 8 minutes.
Add the diced carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the sliced Irish sausages and cook until browned, breaking them up with a spoon as they cook.
Add the diced potatoes, garlic, and chicken broth to the saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the cooked quinoa and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
